bignews.title: EPCOT Food & Wine Festival menus released for August 27 start
bignews.body: Disney published the complete lineup of Global Marketplace menus for the 2026 EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival, which begins August 27. The festival runs through mid-November with booths featuring new dishes, returning favorites, and a dedicated cheese crawl.

parkioInsight.text: Festival booths tend to have shortest lines during the first week of operation. Arriving at World Showcase opening on August 27–29 usually means walk-up service at most kiosks before lunch crowds arrive.

bignews.title: October access restrictions confirmed at three Walt Disney World parks
bignews.body: Hollywood Studios, EPCOT, and Magic Kingdom will each operate on restricted hours during portions of October due to private events. Seventy-five percent of Walt Disney World theme parks will see limited access periods this fall.

parkioInsight.text: Animal Kingdom tends to absorb overflow traffic on restricted days. If you're visiting during October private events, plan your must-dos there or book early-morning Lightning Lanes at affected parks before closures take effect.

bignews.title: Kidani Village lobby closed for refurbishment at Animal Kingdom Lodge
bignews.body: Parts of the main lobby area at Kidani Village are now under construction at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge. Signs indicate the refurbishment is underway with no published completion date.

parkioInsight.text: Lobby construction noise and barriers may disrupt the usual relaxed atmosphere at Kidani Village. Guests staying there may prefer evening downtime at Jambo House or the pool areas until work wraps up.

topstories.title: Oogie Boogie Bash kicks off with new Haunted Mansion street party
topstories.body: The first Oogie Boogie Bash of 2026 took place last night at Disney California Adventure. The Halloween hard-ticket event introduced a new Haunted Mansion-themed street party and the addition of Yzma from The Emperor's New Groove to the character lineup.

parkioInsight.text: New entertainment typically draws the biggest crowds during the first few weeks of seasonal events. Catching the Haunted Mansion street party near the end of September or early October usually means better viewing spots and shorter treat-trail waits.

topstories.title: Bob Iger honored with Main Street window at Disneyland
topstories.body: Disney CEO Bob Iger received a dedication window on Main Street, U.S.A. at Disneyland during D23 weekend. The tribute recognizes his tenure leading The Walt Disney Company.

parkioInsight.text: New dedication windows tend to attract photo crowds for the first few days. Visiting Main Street during the first hour after rope drop or during evening parades usually offers clearer sightlines for your own shot.

topstories.title: Gordon Ramsay visits new Carnaby restaurant at Downtown Disney
topstories.body: Celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay appeared at The Carnaby in Downtown Disney District alongside Mickey Mouse and Disneyland Resort President Jill Estorino following the restaurant's opening. Ramsay posed for photos in his signature white chef's coat.

parkioInsight.text: High-profile restaurant openings tend to book up quickly during the first month. Walk-up waits at The Carnaby are likely longest during dinner service; lunch or late-night visits may offer shorter queues.

topstories.title: Disneyland begins removing original entrance ticket booths after 71 years
topstories.body: Disneyland Resort has started demolishing four classic entrance ticket booths that have stood since the park's 1955 opening. The removal is part of a larger entrance redesign project.

parkioInsight.text: Construction at park entrances often creates bottlenecks during peak arrival hours. Arriving before official opening or after 11am tends to bypass the heaviest foot traffic and construction detours.

topstories.title: Hollywood Studios transformation nears debut
topstories.body: Disney's Hollywood Studios is preparing for one of its largest visual changes in decades. Guests have only a few weeks remaining before a major park transformation goes live, following years of construction and closures.

parkioInsight.text: Major park unveilings typically drive higher attendance for the first month. Visiting Hollywood Studios before the transformation debut may offer shorter waits on headliners like Slinky Dog and Rise of the Resistance.

topstories.title: Disney reveals new Coco boat ride story and concept art
topstories.body: Disney shared fresh details and concept art for the upcoming Coco attraction under construction behind Pixar Pier at Disney California Adventure. The boat ride's storyline and timeline were outlined during the D23 Expo weekend.

parkioInsight.text: Construction viewing areas near Pixar Pier tend to be least crowded during early morning hours. Checking progress before 10am usually means fewer guests blocking sightlines along the construction fence.

topstories.title: Fall Starbucks collection launches at Disneyland and Walt Disney World
topstories.body: A new Disney and Starbucks fall collaboration is now available featuring Mickey and Minnie pumpkin designs on tumblers, drinkware, a tote bag, and a journal. The collection can be found at the Emporium in Disneyland and Kingswell Camera Shop, plus select Walt Disney World locations.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal Starbucks merchandise often sells out within the first week at flagship stores. Visiting the Emporium or World of Disney within an hour of park opening tends to offer the best selection before popular items disappear.

icymi.title: Disney World hosted princess celebration for Make-A-Wish families
icymi.body: Walt Disney World held a special Disney Princess event at Give Kids The World Village during World Princess Week. The celebration included a second line parade, lanterns, jewelry, and storytelling for wish kids and their families.

icymi.title: D23 merchandise now available online at Disney Store
icymi.body: Products from the 2026 D23 Expo are now live for purchase at DisneyStore.com following the conclusion of the fan event in Anaheim. Items commemorate the convention held over the past weekend.

icymi.title: World of DVC app streamlines vacation rentals and resales
icymi.body: A new World of DVC mobile app launched to simplify browsing confirmed reservations, requesting availability, managing Keyholder Loyalty benefits, and tracking DVC news. The app offers a centralized platform for Disney Vacation Club rental activity.

spotlight.title: Magic Kingdom Halloween treats debut across the park
spotlight.body: New Halloween-themed snacks and treats are now available throughout Magic Kingdom. The seasonal food lineup includes specialty desserts, savory items, and character-inspired sweets at locations across Fantasyland, Tomorrowland, and Main Street.

parkioInsight.text: Specialty treat carts tend to run out of popular Halloween items by mid-afternoon on busy days. Grabbing your must-try snacks before noon usually guarantees availability, especially for limited-run items at Main Street Confectionery.
